entries.summary: remark updated: KCMY is 3 miles west on same runway heading; contact KCMY tower on 124.6 Monday through Friday 1400-2200Z and beyond before entering Class D, use 124.6 CTAF when tower is closed; FARP and static C-130 and C-17 load trainers present; due to inclement weather surfaces may be unusable by fixed wing aircraft so contact range operations for current surface conditions.
entries.original: KCMY 3 MILES W SAME RWY HDG. CTC KCMY TWR (MON-FRI 1400-2200Z++) ON 124.6 PRIOR TO ENTERING CL D. USE CTAF 124.6 WHEN TWR IS CLSD. FARP AND STNR C-130 AND C-17 LOAD TRAINERS. DUE TO INCLEMENT WX SFCS MAY BE UNUSBL BY FIXED WING ACFT. CTC RANGE OPNS FOR CURRENT SFC CONDS.
